name: POCO F6 / Redmi Turbo 3
tagline: Experience the perfect blend of performance and customization with our Pixel-inspired custom ROM for your device.

steps.title: Unlock Bootloader
steps.description: Ensure your device's bootloader is unlocked before proceeding.

steps.title: Reboot To Fastboot
steps.description: Reboot to Fastboot by pressing Vol Down + Power Button.

steps.title: Connection
steps.description: Open CMD or Terminal on your PC and connect your phone via USB.

steps.title: Flash Recovery
steps.description:
Flash recovery by typing:
fastboot flash recovery recovery*.img

steps.title: Reboot To Recovery
steps.description:
Reboot into Recovery typing:
fastboot reboot recovery

steps.title: Wipe Data
steps.description: In recovery, click on factory reset and then do format data.

steps.title: Flash Clover ROM
steps.description:
Select apply update using sideload & install the ROM by typing:
adb sideload CloverProject*.zip

steps.title: Reboot
steps.description: The first boot may take a few minutes. Enjoy Clover!

installationGuide.warning: Incorrect installation may brick your device. We are not responsible for any damage to your device. Proceed at your own risk.

log: Introduce standalone Ulquiorra Manager app for better user experience.
Add KCAL color calibration support directly into Snapdragon Display Engine (SDE) driver.
Overhaul Ulquiorra UI and decouple the ulquiorrad daemon.
Backport Google BBRv3 TCP congestion control and set it as default.
Enable UFS HPB for games that are open world and use dynamic loading.
Add dynamic root task group CPU boost and disable UBSAN overhead.
Disable conflicting Qualcomm perf-lock opcodes in vendor configs.
Fix redirecting party number mistakenly appending to incoming caller ID (credits - @AdarshGrewal ).
Update Leica / MIUI Camera launcher icons with adaptive vector and themed monochrome icon.
Label persist directory for Jiiov optical fingerprint sensor in SELinux.
Fix potential sleep/suspend freezes in kernel SMCInvoke.
Upstream sync with latest LineageOS kernel, devicetree, and modules.
Rewrite the whole implementation for bypass mode.
Implement Touch Filters mode at display driver level (inspiration - @AdarshGrewal ).
Tune little max frequency in Normal mode [ulquiorra] to 2GHz.
Drop invalid perf hints from QTI.
Add back missing hint stack in base.
Add back support for editing profiles in ulquiorra modes.
Add support for Charging modes: Slow, Fast, Turbo.
Add back High touch polling rate.
Drop Libperfmgr in favor of QTI.
Add device modes - Battery, Normal, Performance, Extreme.
Drop Local update option in clover updater(temp.).
Add Local update option in clover updater.
Fixed ringtone not coming through Bluetooth headphones on incoming calls.
Imported QCOM audio effects from OnePlus 9R
Implement Turbo Charging , HTSR , Gamebar , Display Saturation , Per-App Refreshrate
